methodology.card_effect: base outcome - same legal deck context with the focal card replaced by its matched baseline
methodology.censoring: A paired card sample is excluded from the effect estimate if either matched condition reaches the action horizon. Censored matches and pairs remain reported explicitly.
methodology.pair_interaction: Not evaluated in full-pool sweep; select a compatible card subset to evaluate interactions.
methodology.triple_interaction: Not evaluated in full-pool sweep; select a compatible card subset to evaluate interactions.
methodology.ci95: paired percentile bootstrap over decisive per-card matched samples; bounded Hoeffding interval when observed contrasts are constant
methodology.interpretation: Each card is tested in legal contexts containing that card. Effects are policy- and context-distribution-specific, not universal equilibrium values.
